authority: Explicit user 2026-10-13 direction, superseding old source-count-first, date-specific unique-painting quotas, and default artist/style-based suggestions.

evaluationOrder.requirement: For every actual observed Class I date, provide at least one appropriate painting. A distinct major feast, saint or rite should have art depicting its actual feast/event/person; appointed Gospel art can cover Class I Sundays and privileged ferias when relevant, or serve only as an explicitly provisional fallback for feast-specific gaps. Legitimate repetitions (octave, repeated Gospel) may share an eligible painting rather than unique art per date.
include: Every observed I-class day under actual 1962 DayResolver
Selected II/III class figures: Apostles, Evangelists, Doctors, angels, major saints, national patrons
Local/national patron days only where profile/jurisdiction proves an actual observed principal or commemoration
evaluationOrder.exception: Commemoration and feast suppressed by higher-precedence day do not replace the actual principal; a locally valid commemoration may get a separately identified artwork.
evaluationOrder.gapGate: For an observed major feast, generic Gospel, season or Sunday fallback is not counted as the specific major-feast image requirement being satisfied. Preserve separate exact-subject backlog until resolved.

evaluationOrder.requirement: Every substantive module has hero artwork where suited; within a module, cover all distinct art-worthy scenes or prayer meditations.
mandatoryInventory: Seven Last Words of Christ: seven meditation moments (confirm actual route)
Divine Mercy Chaplet: devotional original image/hero and genuinely apt companion art; do not invent five narrative mysteries
Seven Sorrows and other existing chaplets and extended Rosary devotions as verified in runtime
Adoration, Benediction, Confession, novenas, other art-bearing modules
cinematicConstraints: Use suitable frames/vertical crops, coherent cadence, long static holds where needed and low distractions
No unique picture per paragraph requirement; actual meditation scenes may reuse an image if separately justified

evaluationOrder.requirement: Build canonical subject/event IDs shared across Mass Theatre, Biblical Theatre, Bible timeline/genealogy/geography, Calendar, Rosary, Stations, and Prayers. Prioritize verified recurrence and meaningful module breadth above one-off subjects.
measurement: Count distinct actual context references by subject/event ID
Differentiate estimated/user-facing frequency (daily, weekly, yearly, on-demand) from indexed reference count
Log actual liturgical 1962 Gospel repetitions where validated
Log one physical artwork ID with all valid use contexts; never duplicate physical image
Do not treat theatre overlap as verified until the event join exists
highLeverageExamples: Major saints with multiple devotional and Calendar uses

evaluationOrder.requirement: Where historical biblical event is not visual subject, choose the most theologically appropriate symbolic and contemplative masterpieces.
evaluationOrder.iconographicIntegrity: Do not falsely call a symbol a depiction of a distinct Gospel scene.

evaluationOrder.requirement: Additional minor saint/iconographic subjects, lower-rank weekday context, genealogical anchors, Biblical Theatre secondary episodes, and optional historic portraits; avoid manufacturing a mandatory art slot for each story.

For each date lacking an approved appropriate feast/saint picture: (1) candidate for the exact day's appointed Gospel, (2) if none, the approved artwork for the liturgical Sunday's Mass governing that week.
fallbackSequence: exact principal feast/event or approved saint artwork
appointed Gospel of that date with actual source-bound reading and verified scene
governing liturgical Sunday Mass artwork; keep independent date caption and distinct painting subject
guardrails: Fallback cannot be reported as exact-feast visual coverage
Verify temporal week identification, including seasons, vigils, octaves, Holy Week
For regularly reused weekday background prefer artwork individually rated 5/5; do not auto-promote ratings 3/4 or an unrated earlier choice into a repetitive anchor
If no verified 5/5 Sunday anchor exists for reuse, flag human selection rather than automatically reusing a poorer image
Never let artwork caption overwrite the real observed 1962 liturgical principal

aesthetic.eligibility: New user ratings 3,4,5 eligible for final review; 0,1,2 globally excluded regardless thematic fit.
aesthetic.repeatPolicy: Only user-rated 5/5 artworks are automatically eligible for repeated cross-context placements; each placement still requires valid iconographic association, technical rights and crop. Previously subject-approved but unnumbered artwork requires explicit 5/5 approval for repetitive anchor use.
aesthetic.rating4: Strong single placement or occasional art subject; not automatically repeatable.
aesthetic.rating3: Potential final-review/supporting subject candidate; not a homepage/weekday repeat default.

positiveExamples.title: The Last Communion of Saint Mary of Egypt
Saint Catherine of Alexandria in Prison
A Miracle of Saint Joseph of Cupertino

preferences: Accomplished figurative naturalism and convincing anatomy
Devotional solemnity and strong painterly execution
Composition readable on a phone without aggressive crop
No shallow flat/stiff composition merely because iconographic title is correct
aesthetic.specialAuthenticDevotionalImages: Some devotions (e.g. Divine Mercy) have specific historically venerated images; respect their exact devotional identity instead of replacing it with a more decorative picture. Verify official source and reproduction rights separately.

measurements.researchCoverage: Relevant subject with at least one source-authenticated, visually screened user-eligible original
measurements.curatorialFinalReview: User numeric rating >=3 or earlier subject selection preserved for human final review (not production approval)
measurements.crossContextReuse: Use same hash/original with separate accurate subject/context tags; automated repeat only 5/5 after verifying appropriateness
measurements.moduleHero: Distinct approved hero candidate, permitted cross-module reuse only under 5/5 gate
measurements.cinematicMoment: Artwork available at meditation moment; not automatically unique per scene
measurements.calendarDay: Actual DayResolver date and proper matched to artwork exact/gospel/sunday_fallback, with relationship recorded
measurements.legalRelease: Per-original object identity, rights for commercial/offline distribution and phone crop passed
measurements.frequency: Observed context/route count and calendar recurrence measured separately from number of paintings

currentBaseline.status: Policy and reference demands recorded; no Calendar/Mass Theatre/Bible Theatre/cinematic runtime integration claimed.

implementationOrder: Source-register each art-bearing module hero and moments (including 4×5 Rosary and supplemental devotions)
Join validated 1962 Class I and selected observed II/III dates to art-subject/event ID
Merge module event IDs across Theatre/Atlas/genealogy/geography and rank by references, cadence and cultural importance
Match existing 170 review-eligible images before new image research
Research subject gaps in high-impact batches guided by 5/5 vs 0–2 look
Assemble user-facing final atlas and verify rights/mobile/offline QA before release
sourceEvidenceCaveat: Current seed is explicit prior iconography/prayer crosswalk only; no claim of measured screen-open frequency, full Theatre/Atlas joins or all module implementation.
